# ztna_connector_scheduled_upgrade (Data Source)

Get Connector Scheduled Upgrade



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `oid` (String) Parent connector OID.

### Read-Only

- `image_id` (String) The connector image version ID to upgrade to.
- `scheduled_download` (String) The scheduled download time in RFC3339 format (UTC).  If omitted, defaults to current UTC time.
- `scheduled_upgrade` (String) The scheduled upgrade time in RFC3339 format (UTC).  Must be after the scheduled_download time. If omitted, defaults to current UTC time.
- `tfid` (String)
